## Why

The problem and the approach, in one to three sentences. Add `Closes #N` when this PR fully resolves a spec or bug issue.

## What changed

One to three bullets. Name a path or a symbol only when it carries the change.

## Scope

What this PR covers and what it leaves out on purpose, such as a follow-up or a known gap.

## Tradeoffs

The alternatives a reviewer would ask about, one line each.

## Blast Radius

Who or what this PR touches, and why that is safe or risky.

## Verification

- `scripts/check.sh --all`, with its last lines.
- The acceptance checks from the issue, run on the real program, with the decisive output.

List a check that did not run as a gap. If a part works and you do not know why, say so.

## Suggested AGENTS.md additions

A trap met in this PR that meets the three criteria in AGENTS.md, with the proposed wording.
